name: Multiplayer Edit X
description: Fork of Multiplayer Edit by xXoanon, retaining the stable 0.5.0 editor/WebRTC lifecycle while extending synchronization, reliability, Room Settings, and selectable WebRTC/TURN/HTTP relay transports.

signaling-url.name: Signaling Server URL
signaling-url.description: URL of the signaling server used for connection setup.

connection-mode.name: Connection Mode
connection-mode.description: Auto prefers the stable direct/STUN WebRTC path, retries through configured TURN when available, then falls back to HTTP Relay. WebRTC disables relay fallback. TURN forces configured TURN/UDP. HTTP Relay connects through the signaling server immediately.

turn-host.name: TURN Host
turn-host.description: Hostname or IPv4 address of the TURN server. Port 3478/UDP is used by this build.

turn-password.name: TURN Password
turn-password.description: TURN password for this client. Kept in local Geode settings and never embedded into release builds.

force-turn-relay.name: Force TURN Relay
force-turn-relay.description: Force WebRTC ICE traffic through TURN for diagnostic testing. Requires a TURN password.

player-name.name: Player Name
player-name.description: Your display name in multiplayer sessions.

show-cursors.name: Show Player Cursors
show-cursors.description: Display other players' cursor positions in the editor.
